page.title: People
page.intro: The people who sign in here and whether their synchronization works. You see their email, role, sign-ins, and sync status, never their calendars, connected account emails, or events.

empty.title: Nobody matches
empty.body: No one here matches this search and these filters.

beyond.title: This page is empty
beyond.body: Fewer people match than when this page was opened.

actions.label: Actions for {email}
actions.changePlanHint: Choose which plan limits this person.
actions.makeAdministratorHint: They can manage people, storage, and who can join. They still never see anyone else's calendars.
actions.removeAdministratorHint: They keep their own calendars and rules.
actions.disableHint: They cannot sign in, and their rules wait until you enable them again.
actions.enableHint: They can sign in again, and their rules resume.
actions.passwordResetHint: A link they use once to choose a new password.
actions.deleteHint: Deletes their sign-in, rules, and calendar connections, and the events their rules wrote. Their calendar accounts and their own events stay.

status.disabled: {email} can no longer sign in. Their rules wait until you enable them again.

deletedEvents.one: {count} event their rules wrote was deleted.
deletedEvents.other: {count} events their rules wrote were deleted.

left.one: {count} rule could not reach its calendar, so its events stay there, no longer managed.
left.other: {count} rules could not reach their calendars, so their events stay there, no longer managed.

delete.title: Delete {email} permanently?
delete.body: This deletes their sign-in, rules, calendar connections, tokens, and Activity. The events their rules wrote are deleted from their calendars wherever Calendar Ghost can still reach them. Their own events and their calendar accounts stay as they are. Backups taken before now keep their records until they rotate out. This cannot be undone.

reset.title: Copy the password reset link for {email} now
reset.body: Send it to them yourself. It works once, until {expires}, and is shown only once. You never see or set their password.
reset.label: Password reset link for {email}

invitations.title: Invitations waiting
invitations.body: Each link works once, for 7 days. Send it to the person yourself; they choose their own email and password.

reveal.title: Copy the invitation link now
reveal.body: Send it to the person you invite. It works once, until {expires}, and is shown only once.
reveal.label: Invitation link

invitations.revoked: The invitation was revoked. Its link no longer works.

empty.title: No invitations are waiting
empty.body: Invite someone to create a link they can use once to join.

verdict.stalled: Calendar Ghost has not checked calendars recently, so nothing synchronizes until the service runs again.
verdict.stopped: A rule stopped syncing and writes nothing until it is fixed.
verdict.review: Rules keep running, but something kept happening or events could not be synced.
verdict.waiting: A calendar provider is limiting or failing requests. Calendar Ghost retries by itself.
verdict.paused: Rules exist, but none is running.
verdict.healthy: Every rule is running and up to date.

overview.noCalls: No calls to calendar providers since {since}.

problem.overdue: Not synced in over a day

ifTheyAsk.reauthorize: If they ask for help: they reauthorize their {account} in Settings, under Connections.
ifTheyAsk.preview: If they ask for help: they open the rule and preview it again to restart it.
ifTheyAsk.activity: If they ask for help: their Activity explains what happened and what to do.
ifTheyAsk.overdue: If they ask for help: they choose Sync now on the rule, or check their Activity.
ifTheyAsk.calendar: If they ask for help: they open the rule to choose another calendar, or remove the rule.

reauthorize.self: Reauthorize your {account} in Settings, under Connections.

preview.self: Open the rule and preview it again to restart it.

activity.self: Activity explains what happened and what to do.

overdue.self: Choose Sync now on the rule, or check Activity.

next.waiting: Nothing to do: Calendar Ghost retries by itself.
next.stalled: Restart Calendar Ghost on the computer it runs on. Nobody's rules synchronize until it runs again.

calendar.self: Open the rule to choose another calendar, or remove the rule.

administrator.administrator: You fix this as the administrator, in {console}.
administrator.person: You fix this as the administrator, in {console}. {name} has nothing to do.

ownCause.person: {name} can fix this from their dashboard.
ownCause.unknown: {name} can try again from their dashboard.

callsMeaning.limited: {Provider} asked Calendar Ghost to slow down a few times, and it tried again later.
callsMeaning.manyFailed: Many calls failed. A {account} usually needs reauthorization, or {provider} is having trouble.

health.title: Installation health

summary.stalled: Calendar Ghost stopped checking calendars, so nobody's rules synchronize until the service runs again.

healthy.one: Synchronization works for the {count} person here.
healthy.other: Synchronization works for all {count} people here.

summary.paused: Synchronization is paused for everyone here.

health.needsYouDetail: Only you can fix what is below.

ownFixes.one: {count} of {total} people has something to fix on their own dashboard.
ownFixes.other: {count} of {total} people have something to fix on their own dashboard.

health.secretExpiring: The {provider} client secret expires on {date}. Put a new one in place before then, or every {provider} account stops.
health.secretExpired: The {provider} client secret expired on {date}. Every {provider} account stopped; put a new secret in place to restart them.

testingMode.one: {count} person lost access about 7 days after connecting, which usually means the OAuth app at {provider} is in Testing mode.
testingMode.other: {count} people lost access about 7 days after connecting, which usually means the OAuth app at {provider} is in Testing mode.

unrecognized.one: {count} person failed for a reason Calendar Ghost does not recognize. The service logs name {provider}'s reason.
unrecognized.other: {count} people failed for a reason Calendar Ghost does not recognize. The service logs name {provider}'s reason.

plainHttpAddress.one: {count} person wants instant sync, but calendar providers report changes only to an HTTPS address, and this installation's public address uses plain HTTP.
plainHttpAddress.other: {count} people want instant sync, but calendar providers report changes only to an HTTPS address, and this installation's public address uses plain HTTP.

noticesNotArriving.one: {count} person wants instant sync, but {provider} cannot reach this installation, so changes in {calendar} wait for the next scheduled sync.
noticesNotArriving.other: {count} people want instant sync, but {provider} cannot reach this installation, so changes in {calendar} wait for the next scheduled sync.

person.intro: You see whether their synchronization works, never their calendar names, connected account emails, or events.

missing.title: Nobody here has this address
missing.body: This person may have been deleted.

fact.laterDefault: The default plan, once plans are on

plans.title: Plans
plans.intro: Plans limit how many rules, calendar accounts, and Integration Tokens each person may have, and how soon their calendars sync. Administrators are never limited.

enabled.label: Limit people with plans
enabled.hint: While this is off, nobody is limited.

default.label: Default plan
default.hint: People without a plan of their own have it, including people who join later.

interval.instant: Instant sync, and a check every 5 minutes

editor.name: Name
editor.keyHint: Lower-case letters, digits, and hyphens. The key cannot change later.

lowerWarning.one: This plan limits {count} person. Rules beyond a lower limit keep syncing, but no new rule can start until the count is within it.
lowerWarning.other: This plan limits {count} people. Rules beyond a lower limit keep syncing, but no new rule can start until the count is within it.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name}?
removeConfirm.body: Nobody can have this plan afterwards. Rules, accounts, and tokens stay as they are.

cause.label: Likely cause: {cause}.
cause.api_disabled: {api} is turned off for this installation
cause.quota_exceeded: this installation's daily quota of {provider} requests is used up
cause.oauth_client_invalid: {provider} no longer accepts this installation's OAuth client
cause.calendar_forbidden: the {account} may not change this calendar
cause.calendar_not_found: the calendar no longer exists, or is no longer shared with the account
cause.rate_limited: {provider} asked Calendar Ghost to slow down
cause.unknown: {provider} refused for a reason Calendar Ghost does not recognize
